title: Load Balancing Worker
description: A starting point for building a custom Runpod load balancing worker. Exposes a FastAPI HTTP server that receives requests directly, without a queue.

input.name: Server Port
input.description: Port the FastAPI server listens on. Must match the HTTP port exposed by your endpoint.

input.name: Health Check Port
input.description: Port Runpod uses to reach the /ping health check. Usually the same as the server port.
